title: Komyo-ji — Temple of the Autumn Light
description: A timber Buddhist main hall with a sweeping irimoya roof and projecting prayer porch, a three-storey pagoda with a nine-ring gilded sorin, an incense court and an autumn maple. The hall and pagoda stand on individual stone verandas joined by a narrow pilgrimage path.

sections.name: Sweeping irimoya roof and prayer porch
